summary: Selected and implemented the bounded portable non-backtracking regex backend foundation. Patterns are compiled once per pattern/case/whole-word semantic key, retained compiled state is capped by a locked LRU, unsupported constructs receive typed dialect-aware diagnostics, and line-oriented execution remains the explicitly later W07-S02 scope.

implementation.scopeBoundary: Only the owning Search source, tests and Search documentation were changed. The ignored local campaign state was not staged. No sibling repository, SQL/XML surface, release, publication or installation was modified.

regexOptions: IgnoreCase when case mode is insensitive
backend.compilationBudgetEnforcement: Post-construction guard; pattern length and nesting are rejected before Regex construction because the .NET Regex constructor has no cancellation API.
backend.cacheConcurrency: Locked LRU with immutable Regex values; concurrent requests for one resident semantic key share one compiled instance.
backend.fallbackPolicy: No silent backtracking-engine, dialect or literal-mode fallback.
backend.executionBoundary: This scope supplies validation and compilation primitives. Line-oriented source matching is W07-S02 and capture-row exposure is W07-S03.

newScenarios: Supported profile uses invariant non-backtracking options, timeout and captures
Same-start alternatives preserve regex source order
Malformed syntax names the portable dialect
Lookahead and lookbehind are rejected with typed dialect-aware diagnostics
Numeric and named backreferences are rejected with a literal-mode remedy
Contiguous-match anchors (\G) are rejected with a typed diagnostic
Atomic groups, conditionals and balancing groups are rejected
Oversized patterns and excessive nesting fail before construction
A 4,096-branch alternation compiles within the selected pattern budget
Repeated and concurrent semantic keys share compiled instances
Cache pressure stays at 128 entries and evicts the least-recently-used key
requiredCoverage: Invalid patterns, unsupported lookaround and backreferences produce typed diagnostics naming the dialect and remedy.
Huge alternation and nesting inputs exercise bounded construction safeguards.
Repeated semantic keys compile once, while changed case semantics remain isolated.
Concurrent same-key requests share one immutable compiled Regex.
Cache pressure is bounded and eviction is deterministic.

knownLimitations: This scope establishes the backend and validation foundation; line-oriented matching integration is W07-S02 and capture-row exposure is W07-S03.
Whole-word mode is part of the immutable cache key but its scanner enforcement is intentionally deferred to the later execution scope.
The compilation budget is a post-construction guard because the .NET Regex constructor cannot be cancelled; bounded pattern length and nesting are the pre-construction controls.
The repository-wide suite retains 31 existing expected skips and 3 platform-conditional symlink skips; no package was published, pushed, released or installed.
